resources.string: Rin terminal — type help for commands
No program is waiting for input.
Session cleared — all declarations were forgotten.
No declarations in this session yet.
… %1$d earlier lines hidden (copy / share / grep still include them)

Commands:
 run run the open file
 stop stop the running program (also ^C)
 clear clear the screen
 history previous commands (!! repeats the last, !N repeats number N)
 version engine version
 session names declared in this session
 reset forget the session declarations
 grep <t> search the screen
 goto <n> jump to line n in the editor
 copy / share copy or share the whole screen
 <code> anything else runs as Rin code, e.g. let x = 5; then x * 2
Declarations (let / fun / class...) stay between commands; an unfinished command continues on the next line.
Tab completes, ↑/↓ browse history, pinch to zoom. When a program asks for input, answer on the line below; ^C cancels.
